p1.title: Luna/r
p1.desc: Luna/r is my micro moon dedicated to smart physical products. A 3D printing e-commerce where files, materials, and logistics are designed to last: modular design, on-demand printable components, NFC to extend product life into the digital realm. Proprietary CAD pipeline, automated fulfillment, and zero manual file prep: less waste, fewer errors, more value for every gram of material.

p2.title: Farm Automation Systems
p2.desc: Here I work on the productive heart: print farms and small plants. Machine orchestration, material management, and workflows designed to keep printers running, not people up late. The goal is not just +40% production speed: it's production that consumes less human time, less waste in trial-and-error, and more process intelligence for every order.

p3.title: FabLab Projects
p3.desc: The FabLab is the micro moon where the low-impact future is experimented with. Robotics, IoT, and digital fabrication used to build prototypes that can become stable systems, not just trade show demos. Every field test generates guidelines, templates, and replicable practices for companies that want to do Industry 4.0 without throwing money at showcase projects.

p4.title: Dream Frequency / Neuro-Tech
p4.desc: This is the most experimental micro moon: dreams, brain data, multimodal interfaces. A research project exploring how to visualize brain frequencies during sleep, transforming them into visual and sound experiences, with great attention to ethics, privacy, and neural data ownership. Here too, the logic is circular: data is not extracted and sold, but returned to people as tools for introspection, creativity, and awareness.

framework.title: The Micro Moons Framework
framework.vision_lead: Instead of monoliths, I design constellations of interconnected micro-systems.
framework.vision_detail: Every Micro Moon is a functional laboratory: it tests innovation, validates impact, and standardizes winning solutions.
framework.vision_method: A circular method that reduces risks and transforms every project into a reusable and scalable asset.

methodology.title: Long-Orbit Project Management
methodology.intro:
I don't launch projects, I design orbits.
Every system is engineered for economic and operational self-sufficiency, eliminating dependence on emergency interventions. I plan, design, and measure with a single purpose: to guarantee concrete impact and scalable margins.

s3.desc: Measuring efficiency, impact, and avoided waste.

about.title: About
about.lead: Bridging the gap between Hardware Engineering and Digital Strategy.
about.p1: I operate at the intersection of Industry 4.0 and custom software development. Unlike traditional agencies, I offer a vertical integration of skills—from CAD optimization (DfAM) to full-stack e-commerce automation.
about.p2: Based in Bologna, a hub for high-tech mechanics. My approach combines the precision of manufacturing consultancy (SolidWorld approach) with the agility of modern digital product labs (MadeInAdd model).
